name: World Hardcore Wrestling World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Won by "Iron" Mike Austin from Curt X in a steel-cage main event at February Massacre; this collection's holdings do not trace the lineage before or after.

name: World Hardcore Wrestling United States Championship
epitaph: Retained by "Wildchild" Ryan Decker over Pitbull in a ladder match at February Massacre, following an earlier defense against Hellspawn; this collection's holdings do not trace the lineage before or after.
